exposure: head circumference to femur length (HC/FL) ratio
cohort: Pregnant patients with breech presentation at term who underwent external cephalic version (ECV) from January 2020 to January 2023 in China.
finding: An increased amniotic fluid index (AFI), the use of terbutaline, and a lower head circumference to femur length (HC/FL) ratio were associated with a successful external cephalic version (ECV).
mod_finding: Successful ECV for breech presentation increases the likelihood of a vaginal birth.
